title: Thought I'd share some experiences
content: I just learned about this sub, and honestly didn't think other people had dreams like this. I have dreams that almost always take place in the same fake town. One of the locations in my fake town is some kind of gigantic mall, with tons of stores, restaurants, and various other attractions. There is a college/dorm building that seems like a giant apartment complex with tons of rooms and open lounge areas. Theres a school that is basically a cross between my real world middleschool and highschool, with tons and tons of classrooms and halls that down actually exist. These dreams never fail to intrigue me, because they always feel so real and vivid, like I'm simply living in a different world when I sleep.
